question: According to Figure 4D-2, what are the general minimum and maximum longitudinal distances from the stop line for the primary signal faces, absent the near-side supplemental-face exception?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Figure 4D-2 shows that the primary signal faces must be located at least 40 feet beyond the stop line and no more than 180 feet beyond the stop line (for 12-inch signal faces), unless a near-side supplemental signal face is provided. The figure also shows an intermediate maximum of 120 feet from the stop line that applies to 8-inch signal faces. Standards (mandatory): - "A signal face installed to satisfy the requirements for primary left-turn signal faces (see Sections 4F.02 through 4F.08) and primary right-turn signal faces (see Sections 4F.09 through 4F.15), and at least one and preferably both of the minimum of two primary signal faces required for the through movement (or the major turning movement if there is no through movement) on the approach shall be located: 1. No less than 40 feet beyond the stop line, and 2. No more than 180 feet beyond the stop line unless a supplemental near-side signal face is provided." - "The primary signal faces that are used to satisfy the requirements of Item A shall simultaneously satisfy the lateral placement requirement described in Section 4D.07 (see Figure 4D-2)." - The same faces must also lie within the 20-degree lateral cone: "At least one and preferably both of the minimum of two primary signal faces required for the through movement... shall be located between two lines intersecting with the center of the approach at a point 10 feet behind the stop line, one making an angle of approximately 20 degrees to the right of the center of the approach extended, and the other making an angle of approximately 20 degrees to the left of the center of the approach extended." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 4D-2 depicts the placement area with dimension callouts of "40 ft*" (minimum distance of signal faces from stop line), "120 ft**" (maximum distance from stop line for 8-inch signal face), and "180 ft***" (maximum distance from stop line for 12-inch signal faces, unless a near-side supplemental signal face is used), all measured within the 20°/20° cone originating 10 feet behind the stop line. [Image 5] The full-page view of Figure 4D-2 confirms the same 40-ft minimum and 120-ft/180-ft maximums and the accompanying footnotes. Citations: - Section 4D.08 Standard §1 (p.673) - Section 4D.07 Standard §1 (p.671) - Figure 4D-2 (p.672)
gold_answer: At least 40 feet and no more than 180 feet beyond the stop line.
